composition.asset_resolution: cell.scene_asset -> css_scene_fallback; scene_objects are decorative multi-cell cuts only

common_kit.role: Reusable surfaces, props, overlays, and masks. Puzzle assets may override it.

scene_slices.usage: Visual-only slices cut from one complete top-down scene; region borders and puzzle facts remain matrix-driven.

cafe-table-1x2.usage: visual-only multi-cell cut; does not change walkable, region, clues, or solution

courtyard-fountain-2x2.usage: visual-only multi-cell cut; does not change walkable, region, clues, or solution

region-grade.usage: Scheme A: region-masked grading over the approved scene crop, then cut back into 36 visual-only cells.

background-objects.usage: Scheme B: one complete board background carries floors and rooms; common object PNGs are semi-transparent visual overlays.

background.usage: asset is optional page atmosphere; board_asset is deterministic programmatic board rendering; board logic remains cell driven
